data.one_liner: Flutter package that exposes Lucide.dev icons as IconData constants.
data.what_it_does: The package bundles the Lucide icon set and generates a LucideIcons class with static IconData members for each icon. Developers can use these icons directly in Flutter widgets like Icon.
use_when: You need a large, open‑source icon collection in a Flutter app
You want a drop‑in replacement for built‑in Material icons without extra setup
avoid_when: You require custom SVG manipulation or animation per icon
You need icons that are not part of the Lucide set
weaknesses: Only provides static icons, no built‑in animation
Package size adds all icons even if only a few are used

alternatives.name: lucide_icons_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Another package exposing the same Lucide icons, may have different versioning or API preferences

alternatives.name: font_awesome_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer the Font Awesome icon set instead of Lucide

alternatives.name: material_symbols_icons
alternatives.why_pick_it: For using Google's Material Symbols icons
